usageNote: 名词短语！夸人有创意时用，带点钦佩感。跟copied idea正好相反，说这个就是在夸你没抄别人！

examples.en: That was a truly original idea — nobody had thought of it before!
examples.zh: 那真是个独创的想法——之前没人想到过！

examples.en: The startup succeeded because the founder had an original idea that disrupted the market.
examples.zh: 这家初创公司成功了，因为创始人有个颠覆市场的原创想法。
